sources.title: huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated
sources.snippet: Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated is a 9 billion parameter language model developed by huihui-ai, based on the Qwen3.5-9B architecture. This model has undergone an "abliteration" process to significantly reduce its safety filtering and refusal behaviors. It is intended for research and experimental use where the generation of sensitive or controversial content is a known and accepted risk ...

sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-Abliterated: What This Uncensored Model Does
sources.snippet: Use the model in sandboxed environments to study refusal removal techniques and their implications for language model design. Consider running it via Ollama for easy local deployment and experimentation without external API dependencies. This is a simplified guide to an AI model called Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated maintained by huihui-ai.
